text:
maria: heads-up — saw a cascade of Sync errors in the app-of-apps this morning. Multiple downstream apps are in 'OutOfSync' with repeated sync loops. GPU node-pool hasn't scaled, pods stuck Pending.

aj: which apps specifically? any error lines from argocd UI?

maria: app list snippet: 
```
apps-prod/app-gpu-training  OutOfSync  Sync Failed  3 retries
apps-prod/model-serving    OutOfSync  Hook Failed  1 retry
```
logs show application-controller repeating 'create failed: admission webhook "validate.example.com" denied' and then a prune attempt that returns 'resource not found'

devon: pasted controller log lines: 
```
E0407 09:12:34.123 application_controller.go:742] failed to apply resources for apps-prod/app-gpu-training: failed to create resource: admission webhook "validate.crds.k8s.io" denied the request
W0407 09:12:34.456 application_controller.go:1200] prune skipped for apps-prod/app-gpu-training: resource not found
```

sara: I think this started after the nodegroup change from yesterday — infra-oncall, did the aws_eks_node_group update go through? labels might have changed and GPU daemonset selectors aren't matching.

infra-oncall: yes, we pushed a terraform change (1765-eks-nodegroup) to switch to a launch_template to fix kubelet args. Node names changed (LT name prefix). Autoscaler attached but new nodes aren't showing the label `accelerator=nvidia`. We're investigating.

argocd-bot: Application apps-prod/app-gpu-training has been stuck in Sync (3 attempts). Auto-prune is enabled.

aj: looks like two problems: 1) nodes missing label so GPU pods Pending, 2) ArgoCD attempted to prune orphaned resources and failed because of admission webhook mismatch. We should stop automated prune on the app-of-apps until cluster state stabilizes.

maria: agreed. temporary mitigation: patch the app-of-apps to disable prune and requeue a manual sync only after nodes come up. Command: `kubectl -n argocd patch application apps-prod --type merge -p '{"spec": {"syncPolicy": {"automated": {"prune": false}}}}'`

devon: +1. also suggest restarting argocd-application-controller to clear stuck hooks: `kubectl -n argocd rollout restart deploy/argocd-application-controller` and tail logs: `kubectl -n argocd logs deploy/argocd-application-controller -f`

infra-oncall: trying to repro node label issue locally — found that launch_template omitted `user-data` kubelet label args. Re-applying patch to add `--node-labels=accelerator=nvidia` to kubelet systemd unit. Planning a quick rolling update of nodegroup. ETA ~18m.

sara: once nodes join, run `kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia -o wide` and then manually scale the GPU daemonset if needed. If pods still Pending check tolerations/taints with `kubectl describe pod`

maria: after we recover nodes, set argocd back to prune=true and run a targeted sync for apps-prod/app-gpu-training and apps-prod/model-serving. Also open to pinning sync-waves to ensure infra resources apply before workloads (use `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave` annotation).

aj: good call — add sync-wave on infra app manifests (value 0) and workloads (value 10) so future runs don't delete infra before workloads. We should add a short doc to repo about sync-wave conventions.

devon: quick note — the admission webhook error came from a validating webhook for our custom cert manager. It rejects resources created without correct ownerRef annotation. That made ArgoCD treat resources as mismatched and try prune. When we re-add ownerRef the webhook accepts. We should add ignoreDifferences for that webhook path if it's noisy.

infra-oncall: node relaunch finished, 2 nodes came up with label accelerator=nvidia. Confirmed with: 
```
$ kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia -o wide
NAME                       STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
ip-10-0-12-34.ec2.internal Ready    <none>   2m    v1.25.7
ip-10-0-13-45.ec2.internal Ready    <none>   1m    v1.25.7
```

maria: proceeding with manual sync now (no prune). If apps reconcile cleanly we'll enable prune and re-sync for final cleanup.

argocd-bot: Manual sync requested for apps-prod/app-gpu-training by maria. Sync initiated.

aj: action items: infra-oncall fix LT user-data (done), devx/doc to add sync-wave conventions (sara), ops to add ignoreDifferences for cert webhook ownerRef path (devon). I'll follow up on a brief postmortem tomorrow.

maria: thanks all — I'll monitor the syncs and close the loop. :thumbsup:
